target.name: Element Active — Enter to select, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "State — Active":
  - heading "State — Active" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Identifier
  - textbox "Identifier": Active
  - text: Stereotype (e.g. <<choice>>)
  - textbox "Stereotype (e.g. <<choice>>)"
  - text: Highlight color (#hex or name)
  - textbox "Highlight color (#hex or name)"
  - text: Texture
  - combobox "Texture":
    - option "None" [selected]
    - option "Hatched"
    - option "Crosshatch"
    - option "Dotted"
    - option "Grid"
    - option "Striped"
  - group "Sub-states":
    - text: Sub-states
    - textbox "Sub-state 1 name":
      - /placeholder: Sub-state name
      - text: Waiting
    - button "Remove sub-state 1": ✕
    - textbox "Sub-state 2 name":
      - /placeholder: Sub-state name
      - text: Sub
    - button "Remove sub-state 2": ✕
    - button "+ Add sub-state"
  - paragraph: Press Delete to remove. Press F2 to focus the name. Drag to reposition.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
